scientific_north_star: Discover independently replicated, new learned representations that transfer to unseen causal relationships, variable bindings and compositional reasoning, not synthetic throughput.

historical_consumed_evidence.BY_original_results: 12 frozen new-seed synthetic tasks; BX 6 correctly paired positives not BQ, 0 hard false positives, 0 BQ baseline-positive losses; 6 original AZ abstentions, 9 native input/work ineligible/mismatched, 2 BX abstentions. Source-neutral engineering observation only, no resource or scientific admission.
historical_consumed_evidence.prior_strength: BQ is a trained but weaker mechanism than BX on this engineering panel. Therefore do not call BQ/identity alone the strongest eligible comparator.
historical_consumed_evidence.replay_policy: All BY, BX, BU, original BM/BN/BO/BP/BQ, original 192 TRAIN cases are CONSUMED: never reuse for candidate development, source selection, learned weights, parameter search, comparator selection, outcome-driven threshold tuning or fresh scientific firstuse. Retain original observations unchanged.
historical_consumed_evidence.new_families_status: Two external independent source births NOT authenticated: F124-BV #586 remains BLOCKED, all 924xxx/925xxx development and 128x2 sealed cohorts unconsumed.

scientific_hypothesis.candidate: Compact learned variable-binding relational state: infer reusable role-to-role binding operators from public FIT alone, compose learned bindings along unseen causal graph paths, permit abstention on uncertain or contradictory binding, never derive state from labels, private oracle, graph truth or CHECK. A novel explicit equivalence/causal binding abstraction rather than just one more tuned BQ/BX shear.
scientific_hypothesis.representation_budget: Frozen maximum 32 bits of learned persistent structural parameters plus unchanged native fixed 7 active / 9 retained cells. Count all temporary and training states and peak RSS in complete task resource budget. No silent capacity or additional retained records.
scientific_hypothesis.mechanism_first: Freeze executable algorithm, parameter schema, memory bounds and maximum FIT search operations under a separate source identity BEFORE independent new source birth/consumption. No new candidate source implemented or claimed accepted by this contract.
scientific_hypothesis.negative_policy: Retain failures, abstentions, comparator successes and unrepresentable structures as original evidence; never silently rerun or seed-substitute.

trained_comparators.role: unaltered published native policy safety baseline
trained_comparators.input: Same public 40 FIT + 8 CHECK, natural route only; no forced native diagnostic
trained_comparators.resource: Actual full-process CPU/RSS when natural native path qualifies; ineligible cases count as such; never inflate control costs

trained_comparators.role: original fully trained 32-bit reversible two-shear learner
trained_comparators.input: Same public FIT/CHECK, frozen source-blind inference and veto

trained_comparators.role: strongest demonstrated structurally learned third-shear 32-bit control
trained_comparators.input: Same public FIT/CHECK, frozen FIT-only flag selection and CHECK veto. Must include all original 10240 residual evaluations and original BQ fit cost, no oracle labels.

trained_comparators.role: A separately preregistered, equally informed learned relationship/binding representation if eligible; no identity or untrained baseline substitution
trained_comparators.input: Same FIT/CHECK, equal frozen stored-state, scratch-memory and training-compute budget as candidate; actual source and original test receipts required before trial; missing arm fails admission rather than silently removing it.

comparator_selection: For predictive accuracy, beat the *strongest eligible fully trained comparator on each frozen cohort*, not an artificially chosen weak arm or an untrained oracle. All arms get identical public observations. Do not use protected cohort results to choose or tune the strongest control. Competitor may not use hidden source identity, oracle, full graph truth or heldout labels.

source_custody.source_reg: Two independent creator+repository original GitHub signed source births after BV frozen protocol, plus independent symbolic oracle and source-only attestation. Confirm semantic grammar novelty beyond consumed BY/BX/BQ/BP. Separate original source author and baseline/candidate mechanism author; signer identity alone insufficient.
source_custody.firstuse: Do not execute any new source unless both external original identities, comparator and candidate original source are frozen and pre-firstuse authenticated; all 24 dev cases consumed exactly once, no replacements. Protected 128x2 only after independent admission and positive dev.
source_custody.data_safety: The private symbolic oracle and independent source family labels must never enter learner FIT, CHECK, mode selection, inference, parameter search or scoring.

frozen_acceptance.public_per_task: 40 FIT pairs, 8 CHECK pairs; FIT may learn, CHECK veto ONLY. One actual causal positive and inventory/topology-matched hard-negative graph per task, 7..12 hop variable-binding composition within fixed 7 active / 9 retained native controls.
frozen_acceptance.threshold_development: On both entire 12-case origin families, zero candidate hard false positives, zero original AZ/BQ/BX/strong trained comparator accepted-positive losses, >=2 net correct paired positives each family beyond strongest trained competitor; all results retained. No science acceptance based solely on small development sample.
frozen_acceptance.threshold_replication: On BOTH independent sealed 128-case cohorts and frozen original trained controls, candidate ≥5 percentage-point net paired causal-positive accuracy improvement over strongest eligible fully trained competitor (at least 7 additional cases per 128 for an unrounded 5pp improvement), zero hard false positives, zero baseline-positive losses, unchanged capacity and complete nonregressing resource cost. No post-firstuse parameter or cohort selection.
frozen_acceptance.resource: For every case independently: natural original AZ and new candidate both execute exact native scorer twice, same normalized graphs/input/outcomes/counters. If AZ naturally abstains, mark resource INELIGIBLE, do not force it; this blocks joint resource admission. Five fresh whole-process Linux trials per arm per case including imports, all public observations, FIT training, CHECK veto, graph inference, actual native calls, memory allocation and training amortization. Candidate median CPU <= strongest eligible trained comparator median CPU on matched workload; candidate median AND maximum RSS <= strongest eligible trained control. No artificial baseline padding or unearned 'matched' claim for different work.
frozen_acceptance.strength: Each eligible control must be genuinely learned/trained on equal public evidence, frozen search budget, same training+temporary cost accounting. BQ weak-only or no-trained-comparator comparison automatically FAIL.
frozen_acceptance.identity_policy: All official results bound to original GitHub signed provider run, exact candidate and comparator blobs, original source birth hash and frozen protocol, retained even when negative.
